messages:
liz: hey team — liz here (first day!). following the onboarding guide and trying to run my first CI. I pushed a branch and Buildkite pipeline errored on a docker pull with 403. Some context: I installed buildkite agent locally and triggered the pipeline `infra-team/ci-onboarding` from the web UI. @sam any ideas?

sam: welcome aboard liz! for private images on registry.redwood-inference.com you need the pipeline to have DOCKER_READ_TOKEN in env. Buildkite pulls as the pipeline user, not the runner. Which pipeline is it again?

liz: pipeline is infra-team/ci-onboarding. I checked Settings > Environment and I only see KUBE_* and SNYK_TOKEN. I also hit a GH Actions error earlier (when testing a repo_dispatch) about missing `workflow` scope on my PAT — is that different?

ash: short answer: yes. GH Actions runner vs Buildkite pipeline use different creds. GH Actions needs a PAT with scopes repo, workflow (and packages if accessing registry). Buildkite needs the DOCKER_READ_TOKEN secret configured (we store it in Buildkite pipeline env). I'll update the devex doc to call that out.

sam: adding DOCKER_READ_TOKEN to infra-team/ci-onboarding now. Also granting liz the "builder" role so she can re-run jobs. Liz, try re-running the failing job.

buildkite-bot: Pipeline infra-team/ci-onboarding #17 restarted by sam — queued :arrow_forward:

liz: re-run shows docker pull succeeded now, thanks. New failure further down: npm step errors with permission denied when trying to create node_modules: 

```
Error: EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/workspace/node_modules'
    at Object.mkdirSync (fs.js:xxx)
    at create (somepath)
```

Is there a known issue with container user permissions?

maria: yep, we switched base images to run as a non-root `node` user recently. Some repo scripts still assume root. Quick fixes: chown the workspace in the image (`chown -R node:node /workspace`) or run the step as root in Buildkite. Better fix is updating the Dockerfile to set proper ownership. I can open a tiny PR to the base image if you want.

liz: opened PR #42 that does `chown -R node:node /workspace` in the Dockerfile and updates the pipeline step to run as user `node`. Restarting the build now.

buildkite-bot: Pipeline infra-team/ci-onboarding #17 restarted by liz — queued

liz: green! all tests passed. huge thanks @sam @maria and @ash for the quick help :party: :thumbsup:

sam: welcome again and ping #devex if you hit more onboarding stuff. I'll follow up to add DOCKER_READ_TOKEN to the onboarding checklist and update the PAT scopes note for GH Actions.

maria: will send the tiny PR to base image and add a short note about non-root images to devex docs.

liz: closing thread — everything working now, thanks everyone :)
